name: Summer Arts Clinic
what_you_do: A week on campus choosing a path in dance, theater, visual art, or fashion design and textiles. Each course ends with a performance or exhibit.
who_can_apply: Students who are finishing grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: Residential $1,375; daily commuter $875; plus a $75 nonrefundable fee. Need-based scholarships are limited.
deadline_text: 2027 registration opens Jan 12, 2027 and closes May 15, 2027. Scholarship forms are due April 1.
how_to_apply: Sign up online. For questions, write to summerartsclinic@precollege.wisc.edu or call 608-890-3260.
notes: You can stay on campus or come each day as a commuter.
